fields.name: pass
fields.description: The admin secret of the server.

fields.name: reason
fields.coerce: tested for truthiness, then sent with no change
fields.description: When it is truthy, every client gets it as `disconnect_reason`.

responses.name: Accepted
responses.when: `pass` matches. The server sends no reply to you; it starts the shutdown (see **Also sent**).

responses.name: Closed
responses.when: When the countdown ends, `shutdown` sets `server.live` to false. Then `sync_loop` disconnects the socket of each character, yours too when your socket has one. On `hardcore` and `test` servers, `sync_loop` skips this.

confirm.note: `sync_loop` returns at the first player on `hardcore` and `test` servers

failures.intro: Admin only. The handler needs no character.

also.when: 10 s later `shutdown_routine` starts. It closes the tavern (refunds, see `bet` and `poker`), sets each monster with a target to 1 HP, and then sends one message per second: for 20 s, 240 s on `hardcore` servers, 1 s on dev servers. Then the server stops.

confirm.note: `x` is `String(seconds - i)`; `nod: true` keeps it out of Discord and the event log

fields.name: code
fields.description: `call_code_function('trigger_event','shutdown',{seconds:N})`: it fires the `shutdown` event of CODE with the countdown in seconds.

confirm.note: Broadcast in the same tick as the timers are set, so it comes before the first `server_message` (a 0 ms timer)

order: 10 s later: `eval` to everyone, then a `server_message` countdown each second
at the end of the countdown: the server closes the socket of each character
